entries.thesis: Defensive staples rotation bid: KO +2.38% on the day with three Buy reiterations (MS $103, BofA $100, RBC $96) and a benign CFO handover. Uptrend intact but extended at 98.17, above the old zone and at the old target; wait for a pullback into the 96.20-96.50 open/premarket shelf rather than chase.
entries.synthesis: Staples complex bid (KO/PG/PEP/MCD all +1.7-2.4%) into a Fed hike tape; analyst PTs 100/103 leave headroom above the 98.30 day-high retest target. Entry only on a pullback to the open shelf with R/R >= 1.5.
entries.edge: Pullback entry at the 96.20-96.50 open/premarket shelf gives R/R 1.64-2.63 to the 98.30 day-high retest with a 95.40 stop under the day low; chasing at 98.17 collapses R/R to ~0.2.
entries.bear_case: Staples rotation reverses (PEP/MCD/PG roll over together); a hawkish 50bp Fed tail headline lifts yields and pressures staples; KO fails the 95.40 stop.
entries.invalidation: Trade below 95.40; staples-rotation reversal; hawkish 50bp Fed tail headlines.
entries.horizon: same-session, flat by 20:50Z before the Nov-25 08:30 ET macro triple
entries.catalyst: CFO succession announced 2026-11-23 21:33Z (Murphy retire 2027, BMY CFO David Elkins effective 2027-04-02); MS calls it benign, keeps Overweight $103.
